Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software

  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização

  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo

Será um diferencial:

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
  • Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Analista de R&S Senior
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Principal.Net Architect

title: Especialista de Conteúdo
description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar
  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

description:

Role Overview:

You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Key Responsibilities:

• Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to \"vet\" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

• Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.

• Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a \"Sales Knowledge Base\" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.

• CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents \"write back\" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.

• AI Tooling: Experience with \"Agent-as-a-Service\" platforms (e.g., 11x, Regie.ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.

• Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.

• Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and \"reasoning loops\" to improve meeting-set rates.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.

  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our \"One World\" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.


In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot

title: Gerente de Inovação em Tecnologia
description:

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Estratégia de Inovação: Liderar a adoção de tecnologias emergentes, com foco especial em IA Generativa e modelos preditivos aplicados ao negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento Ágil: Orquestrar o desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando ferramentas de Low-Code/No-Code para entregas rápidas e escaláveis.
  • Otimização de Processos: Mapear, desenhar e implementar fluxos de trabalho eficientes utilizando ferramentas de BPM e automação.
  • Integração de Ecossistemas: Garantir que diferentes sistemas conversem de forma harmoniosa.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:


1. Inteligência Artificial & Data Science

  • Generative AI Service: Implementação de LLMs integrados às aplicações de negócio.
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Capacidade de conectar a IA aos dados proprietários da empresa para respostas precisas.
  • Serviços Cognitivos: Aplicação da inteligência artificial em tarefas como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, análise de texto e tomada de decisão.
  • Agentes de IA: Desenvolvimento de Digital Assistants que automatizam o atendimento interno via BPM.


2. Integrações & Arquitetura

  • Integration: Criar fluxos ponta-a-ponta entre o ERP, bases on-premises e aplicações de terceiros.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Conhecimento em mensageria e gatilhos em tempo real para automação de processos.


3. Desenvolvimento Low-Code/No-Code

  • Criação de dashboards inteligentes e interfaces de usuário que consomem modelos de IA de forma nativa.
  • Foco em User Experience (UX) para garantir que a inovação seja adotada pelos usuários finais.
  • BPM e Workflow: Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de processos (BPMN 2.0) e ferramentas de automação de fluxo.


4. Plataformas

  • Experiência nos tópicos acima nas plataformas da Oracle e será um diferencial também na plataforma da Pipefy.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de projetos de inovação tecnológica.

Diferenciais:

O que oferecemos:

Atrativos de Infraestrutura e Autonomia:

  • Acesso a Sandbox: Acesso a um ambiente isolado para experimentação de novos serviços (IA, Blockchain, IoT) e preparação de PoCs.

title: FX Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Legal Analyst
description:
Essa vaga é para atuação sênior com foco em contencioso judicial e administrativo e em matérias regulatórias (SUSEP), envolvendo a gestão estratégica de processos, interface com escritórios externos, análise de riscos, estratégias de defesa, controle de prazos e acompanhamento de provisões e contingências. Responsável também pelo suporte ao cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias, interpretação de normas do mercado de seguros e resseguros, elaboração de respostas a demandas regulatórias e interação com áreas internas para mitigação de riscos legais.


Formação

Bacharelado completo em Direito, OAB ativa. Desejável pós-graduação relacionada ao Direito Civil, Direito Securitário ou Contratos


Experiência

Experiência sólida, perfil proativo, analítico e dinâmico, para atuação no departamento jurídico, com foco prioritário em contencioso judicial e administrativo e em matérias regulatórias.

A posição envolve a condução e o acompanhamento estratégico do contencioso, incluindo a interação com escritórios externos, a análise de riscos e provisões, a elaboração de manifestações, bem como o controle rigoroso de prazos. Abrange ainda a atuação no suporte ao cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias, com especial atenção às demandas perante a SUSEP.

De forma residual, o(a) profissional poderá prestar apoio na análise e elaboração de contratos, na resposta a consultas jurídicas internas e no suporte jurídico a projetos específicos das companhias do Grupo Austral.


Atividades

Atuação no contencioso administrativo e judicial, incluindo:

  • acompanhamento dos processos;
  • interface com escritórios externos;
  • análise jurídica das demandas, riscos envolvidos e cenários processuais;
  • apoio na definição e revisão de estratégias de defesa;
  • acompanhamento e validação de provisões, contingências e valores envolvidos nos processos.
  • controle e cumprimento de prazos.


Prestar suporte jurídico em matérias regulatórias (SUSEP), incluindo:

  • apoio no cumprimento de obrigações
  • regulatórias periódicas e eventuais;
  • análise e interpretação de normas aplicáveis ao mercado de seguros e resseguros;
  • suporte na elaboração de respostas a ofícios, consultas e demandas regulatórias;
  • interação com áreas internas para alinhamento regulatório e mitigação de riscos.


Atuar como ponto focal jurídico em temas de contencioso e regulatório, aplicando conhecimento técnico e visão crítica, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos legais e regulatórios da companhia.

De forma residual, prestar apoio em atividades não centrais à posição, tais como:

  • análise e elaboração de contratos e documentos jurídicos;
  • suporte jurídico a projetos específicos das companhias do Grupo Austral, em interface com outras áreas.

title: Sr. Staff Product Designer
description:
Sr. Staff Product Designer | Grupo SBF (Nike & Centauro)

Você não vai apenas jogar o jogo; você vai desenhar o esquema tático que garante que múltiplas squads e jornadas falem a mesma língua e entreguem uma experiência de elite para milhões de atletas/clientes.

  • Tática e Estratégia: Definir padrões de solução que reduzam a dívida de UX e elevem a qualidade estrutural de tudo o que entregamos.
  • Influência no Placar: Direcionar decisões de produto baseadas em dados e métricas, influenciando o roadmap e garantindo que o design seja um motor de negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor.NET / AWS Pleno
description:

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Business Systems Administrator
description:
Business Systems Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Instrutor de Idiomas - Itáliano

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
A VMetrix é uma plataforma SaaS que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.


Propósito do Cargo

Como Senior Java Developer , você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.


Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração.
  • Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe.
  • Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção.
  • Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput.
  • Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.


Design e Arquitetura

  • Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios.
  • Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos.
  • Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos.
  • Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.


Banco de Dados e Integrações

  • Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados.
  • Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados.
  • Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais.
  • Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.


Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment.
  • Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.


Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA

  • Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos.
  • Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe.
  • Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA.
  • Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.


Colaboração e Crescimento

  • Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes).
  • Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema.
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras.
  • Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte.
  • Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual.
  • Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta.
  • Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning.
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing.
  • Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs.
  • Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares.
  • Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant.
  • Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.


O Que Valorizamos:

  • Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana.
  • Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo.
  • Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness.
  • Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe.
  • Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real.
  • Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício.
  • Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.


Processo de Candidatura:

  • Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo .
  • Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo.
  • Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência.
  • Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via , and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on , you’ll jump to the front of the line.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month
